classification.difficultyReason: Identify sinusoidal features, solve for recurring maxima and interpret the solutions in the monthly context.

content.prompt: The function $T=15\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{6}\right)+20$ models the average monthly temperatures in Nelson Springs, starting in January.

children.prompt: Identify the amplitude, period and mean position of the function.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Solve $15\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{6}\right)+20=35$ and explain the meaning of the solutions.

answer.short: $t=0,12,24,\ldots$ months. The average monthly temperature is $35\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in January each year.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}15\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{6}\right)+20&=35\\15\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{6}\right)&=15\\\cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{6}\right)&=1\\\frac{\pi t}{6}&=0,2\pi,4\pi,\ldots\\t&=0,12,24,\ldots\text{ months}\end{align*}$$

The average monthly temperature is $35\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in January each year, since $t=0$ corresponds to January.
